assertion.statement: A new value `seLinuxOptions` was added to the istio-cni chart; on platforms like OpenShift, setting `seLinuxOptions.type` to `spc_t` may be needed or istio-cni-node pods may fail to start.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure depends on platform SELinux constraints (e.g. OpenShift) which the release text does not tie to a static configuration predicate.; consequence: Text says pods 'may fail to start' only on some platforms without the setting; this is conditional and a new optional value, so no definite consequence for an operator doing nothing.
